questionSnapshot.question: In what year did the Haunted Mansion open at Magic Kingdom?

notes: Challenged the common Disneyland/Florida confusion: two primary histories explicitly separate the 1969 and 1971 openings. Opening is a unique dated event and excludes other years without assuming every Haunted Mansion opened together. 599 asks land and 398 asks Roy death; neither tests this opening date. Historical fact, no routine recheck needed. Full topic digests, ranked comparisons, both category digests, and additional cross-bank title/name searches were read for distinctness; only this saved plan is in scope.
